about_the_game:
Overview

Divine Ruins is a mythological puzzle–adventure game set within the forgotten temples of ancient gods.

Released in Early Access, the game represents an evolving journey through divine ruins, where new chambers, puzzles, and narrative layers will be added over time.

Play alone or with a friend as a cursed soul condemned by the gods, trapped in ruins where deities once ruled.
Each temple reflects the domain and wrath of a different god, gradually revealing the truth behind your curse.

Gameplay

Explore sacred chambers filled with mysteries, solve environmental puzzles, and piece together the story of a world shaped by divine punishment.

Each ruin reveals a fragment of the greater narrative — a tale of rebellion, faith, and redemption.

Work together with your partner to overcome intricate mechanisms and uncover the meaning behind the gods’ silence.

The core gameplay loop is fully playable in Early Access, with additional puzzles, locations, and narrative content planned for future updates.

Key Features

  • 1–2 Player Experience
    Face the challenge alone or share the journey with a friend in full co-op play.

  • Mythological Puzzles
    Each room represents a god and introduces unique logic and environmental challenges.

  • Atmospheric Storytelling
    Immersive sound design, haunting music, and cinematic moments bring the ruins to life.

  • Environmental Interaction
    Examine symbols, operate ancient mechanisms, and activate divine structures to progress.

  • Dark Fantasy World
    Explore a realm where light fades and the boundary between mortals and gods begins to blur.

  • Linear but Expanding Narrative
    Progress through interconnected chambers while uncovering your past and the forgotten truths of the gods.

Themes & Atmosphere

Inspired by ancient Greek mythology, Divine Ruins explores themes of loneliness, faith, and the weight of divine judgment.

Echoes of past prayers linger in the halls — and every solved puzzle brings you closer to the truth of your curse.

In Short

Divine Ruins is a story-driven puzzle adventure about the bond between mortals and gods.

Now available in Early Access, the journey has only begun.

Will you escape the divine curse — or become part of it?
